title: FiniteSplitHypercoverExistence
statement: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme $X$, a finite split étale hypercover of $X$ exists, as in [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover].

proof.text: Let E be the identity etale X-scheme and K the constant simplicial object on E. In every degree choose E as the matching scheme, with all projections and the matching arrow identities. The forgetful image of E is terminal in schemes over X: hence every matching cone, including the empty degree-zero cone, has a unique factorization. Naturality and matching compatibility are identity equations and the matching arrow is surjective. Thus K is an ordinary etale hypercover [def-weil-pbc-etale-hypercover].

source.place: constant identity simplicial object and Over.mkIdTerminal

proof.text: Apply the all-degree finite split replacement [lem-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover-replacement] to K and its proved hypercover condition. Forget the map from the resulting finite split hypercover V to K, retaining V as a witness of nonemptiness. This specializes the existing relative construction; it does not use exists_and_cofiltered, whose proof uses the present existence statement.
